---
name: Feature request
about: A new check, harness, transport or configuration option
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What should the guard do**
One paragraph. Say which layer it belongs to (hooks, transparent proxy, gateway) if you know.

**Why**
The attack, false positive or workflow it addresses. A benign-marker example helps; do not include working attack payloads aimed at a specific product.

**Evidence**
If it is a detection change, how it should be measured (`benchmarks/`, `results/`). Detectors only add evidence; nothing a model outputs can authorize a call.
